w: Swamishri performed his morning puja at the Akshardham site. A maha puja was performed with 475 participants prior to the foundation stone laying ceremony by Swamishri. (See special report)

st.t: Akshardham Shilanyas Vidhi, New Delhi, Photo Gallery Assembly
w: The murtis of Lord Akshar Purushottam Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj were placed before a beautifully decorated backdrop of flowers. Swamishri presided during the Shilanyas assembly

An annakut had been arranged before Thakorji. After Swamishri's puja, the symbolic celebration of Swamishri's 83rd Birthday celebration commenced with a traditional dance by BAPS children and youths. The celebration was themed on Swamishri's virtues as described in the shlok "Shobho Sadhugune sada saral ne..." Sadhus spoke about Swamishri's steadfastness in observing the five moral vows prescribed for sadhus, supreme devotion to God, simple, adaptable nature and mundane detachment. Further, the senior sadhus spoke glowingly of the grace of Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj upon Swamishri and his untiring services from the day he was appointed as president of BAPS. The celebration was laced with bhajans and traditional dances. Finally, Swamishri addressed the gathering of 28,000 devotees. Like ever year, devotees also donated blood at the BAPS Blood Donation Camp and availed of the Diabetes Camp.
15 devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Jasdan.
Balmukund Swami said, "You have endured a great deal from everyone."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "What they (Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj) endured, we cannot do."
Every moment, Swamishri remains absorbed in his guru.
Balmukund Swami said to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "You have endured so much from everyone."
Swamishri said, "They (Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj) endured so much; we cannot do as they did."
Swamishri remains absorbed in his guru at every moment.

st.t: HRH The Prince of Wales and HRH The Duchess of Cornwall Visit Swaminarayan Akshardham
w: HRH The Prince of Wales and HRH The Duchess of Cornwall visited Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi, India, on the afternoon of Friday, November 8, 2013.

Prince Charles was greeted with a garland of flowers, a chandlo (vermillion powder) and the tying of the sacred kalva (sacred thread) by Atmaswarup Swami (Head Sadhu) on behalf of His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj – the inspirer & creator of Swaminarayan Akshardham and Spiritual Head of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha. Camilla, Duchess of Cornwall, was also greeted in a traditional Indian manner with the auspicious marks of welcome and goodwill by Rohini Patel, lead volunteer of BAPS Women’s Forum.
The Chairman of Swaminarayan Mandir in London, Jitu Patel, Trustees of Swaminarayan Akshardham and other leading volunteers of BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha welcomed the royal couple upon arrival.

After admiring the Mayur Dwar (Peacock Gate), the royal couple made their way to the Swaminarayan Akshardham Mandir where they admired the world’s ‘Largest Comprehensive Hindu Temple’. Captivated by the intricate hand carvings, Prince Charles said, “I am amazed at your outstanding achievement. I don’t remember seeing anything like this in the world! I promote revival of art and heritage and this (Swaminarayan Akshardham) is perhaps one of the most exceptional examples.” The Duchess of Cornwall also said, “This is an architectural marvel. I cannot believe how intricate the carvings are. How did you create all of this in five years?”

After offering respects by placing flowers at the sacred shrine and viewing the mandir’s architecture, the royal couple visited the Gajendra Pithika (Elephant Plinth) that includes 148 life-sized carved stone elephants depicting message of social harmony, peace and spirituality. Moved by its messages, the Prince said, “The effort you have put into immortalizing them in stone is incredible. What adds value to this place is that you also provide moral, social and spiritual counseling to all the pilgrims and visitors who come here”

Commenting on the 11,000 volunteers who helped create Akshardham, Prince Charles expressed “Where can you get such dedication? His Holiness’s (Pramukh Swami Maharaj) purity and goodness and the selfless spirit of the organization (BAPS Swaminarayan Sanstha) can truly inspire such creations of inspiration. I missed His Holiness today. He is truly a deeply spiritual soul, a great leader.”

Today, after finishing breakfast, when Mahant Swami Maharaj came into his bedroom, the attendant brought radishes in a bowl. They were the first radishes of this season. But before taking them, Swamishri at once asked, "Were they offered to Thakorji?"
When the attendant said "Yes", Swamishri asked again, "There?", meaning, "Were they offered to Harikrishna Maharaj?"
They had not been offered to him. So the attendant went and offered them to Harikrishna Maharaj and brought them back. Only then did Swamishri accept them.
Everyone experienced in Swamishri the truth of "Within, he is filled with devotion..."

ds.t: Out of the cycle of 8.4 million births
w: Having completed his puja and showering blessings, the guru, Mahant Swami Maharaj, said:

"Whoever has been initiated with the vartman has been freed from the cycle of 8.4 million births. One cycle of 8.4 million is completed when 25 zeros are placed after a 7. America has a debt of 300 trillion. That is a 3 with 15 zeros. If we make a stack of hundred dollar notes, it would be 65 miles. If one more zero is added, it would be 650 miles, that is, as far as Delhi. If one more is added, it would reach London. So where would 25 zeros go?

When that many years pass, one cycle of 8.4 million is completed. And we have been initiated with the vartman (snapping his fingers) and we have come out of the cycle. When any sadhu initiates with the vartman by the command of Pramukh Swami Maharaj, the work is done."

A father carrying his disabled child came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. Having received blessings in the line, they were moving on when Swamishri stopped them and said, "Hold him properly... his arm is dangling."
Swamishri takes even more care than the father! Even in meetings moving at speed.
